text.tspan: (A)The net result is that energy is transferred from container
to container
(B)The amount of energy transferred between the containers depends on the type of atoms each contains.
After equilibrium is reached, the atoms in container
will still have a different average kinetic energy
than those in container
(D)All the atoms in container
slow down, and all the atoms in container
speed up.
Answer A
Correct. Container
contains atoms with a higher average kinetic energy, and hence temperature, than
those in container
, so the net energy transfer is from container
to container
The figure above shows a 0.20 m diameter cylinder fitted with a frictionless piston, initially fixed in place. The
cylinder contains 2.0 moles of nitrogen gas at an absolute pressure of 4.0 x 10
Pa. Nitrogen gas has a molar mass
of 28 g/mole and it behaves as an ideal gas.
(a) Calculate the force that the nitrogen gas exerts on the piston.
(b) Calculate the volume of the gas if the temperature of the gas is 300 K.
(c) In a certain process, the piston is allowed to move, and the gas expands at constant pressure and pushes the
piston out 0.15 m. Calculate how much work is done by the gas.
(d) Which of the following is true of the heat energy transferred to or from the gas, if any, in the process in part
_____ Heat is transferred to the gas.
_____ Heat is transferred from the gas.
_____ No heat is transferred in the process.
Justify your answer.
